response.justification: While Bogdan is a clearly experienced, versatile senior engineer, his profile does not match this role's core requirements. His C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, far short of the 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ required. He has no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a Node.js/TypeScript role in retail investment tooling, not capital markets), and no demonstrated SQL Server or Oracle depth.
strengths: 15+ years of broad professional software development experience across many stacks
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development
Experience with low-latency, high-throughput systems (DLang at Dunnhumby)
concerns: Minimal and dated C++ experience (~7 months in 2014–2015), none on Windows platform at scale
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise
No specific SQL Server or Oracle experience; recent work is entirely TypeScript/Node.js

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering fundamentals and CI/CD knowledge
